newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol, Gas Natural Q1 dulled by warm weather. [CORRECTED 18:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Repsol, Gas Natural Q1 dulled by warm weather. [CORRECTED 18:21 GMT]

text.p: Spain's Repsol has informed stock market commission CNMV that first quarter operating results for both it and Gas Natural will be negatively affected by a mild winter.

In a mandatory disclosure to the CNMV, Repsol said: "The climate in the first quarter, particularly in February and March, has been unusually warm, which will have a negative influence on operating results at Gas Natural and Repsol Butano in the first quarter, with the latter also being negatively affected by the temporary suspension of the updating of the price capping." (Corrects to show that it was Repsol Butano and not Gas Natural which was also negatively affected by the temporary suspension of the updating of the price capping.)
Repsol owns 45 percent of Gas Natural.
Repsol's statement also said that it expects taxes of around one percent higher after previously applicable deductions are removed because of a change in the law.
Shares in Repsol fell 70 pesetas, or 1.14 percent, to 3,390 on the news, underperforming the market which was down just 40.10 points, or 0.69 percent, at 5,732.59.
"The mandatory disclosure from Repsol is prompting sales in the petrochemical group," an analyst said.
